summary: Resource-scoped claim sanitizer strips namespace, blocking resource-scoped admin operations in Private
description: Issue summary: On AtlasEdge's Private deployment (VPC), users with resource-scoped roles (e.g. project-level admin) are receiving 403s when invoking admin APIs against the project resource. Impact: Blocks customer admins from performing project-level operations (role binds, model rollout, and key creation) for ~120 users across two projects. Background: Customer uses a custom IdP that emits a namespaced role claim 'urn:atlas:roles' with values like 'urn:atlas:role:project:1234:admin' and 'urn:atlas:role:org:sysadmin'. During Private edge processing we run a claim sanitizer to remove unexpected characters/characters that might upset downstream RBAC evaluation. Actual behavior: Sanitizer strips the 'project:1234:' namespace segment, leaving 'admin' which is interpreted as org-level admin or mapped to a default role, causing the RBAC engine to not match resource-scoped bindings. Expected behavior: Sanitizer should preserve resource scoping segments (project:<id>) or provide a configurable allowlist; RBAC should be able to evaluate resource-scoped roles as emitted by the IdP.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer configures Private deployment with IdP that emits 'urn:atlas:roles' claim containing 'urn:atlas:role:project:1234:admin'.
2) User exchanges SAML/OIDC and obtains token to call Redwood Private admin API (e.g., POST /v1/projects/1234/roles).
3) Request reaches edge-identity-proxy which runs claim sanitizer and forwards token to control-plane authz.
4) Control-plane RBAC denies with 403 when evaluating resource-scoped binding.

comments: 2026-03-10 - Maya Chen (Support): Customer reports ~120 users across 2 projects cannot perform project admin tasks after a recent Private control-plane update. Provided sample token and request traces.
2026-03-10 - Diego Alvarez (SRE): Triaging. Initial hypothesis: claim normalization/sanitizer change in 2026-03-05 edge release. Asked for raw IdP assertion and edge proxy logs.
2026-03-11 - AtlasEdge (Customer): Sent SAML assertion and example API request. Clarified that role namespace format is stable and used by other tools in their stack.

2026-03-11 - Priya Kapoor (Auth Eng): Reproduced locally by feeding sample claim through sanitizer function. Confirmed sanitizer regex removes 'project:<digits>:' segments. Marked as regression introduced by commit 7a3f2c (PR #1234).

2026-03-12 - Diego Alvarez (SRE): Opened internal PR to make sanitizer preserve 'project:<id>' segments and add configuration flag to allowlist namespaced segments. Patch linked below. Not yet deployed to customer's cluster.

2026-03-12 - Maya Chen (Support): Notified customer of workaround to use an interim claim mapping on IdP side (map 'urn:atlas:role' to a secondary claim 'x-redwood-roles-preserve' containing full namespace). Customer will evaluate but prefers fix on Redwood side.

2026-03-12 - Priya Kapoor (Auth Eng): Adding unit tests and integration test for namespaced roles. Will coordinate canary rollout to staging then prod. Estimated ETA for hotfix rollout: 2026-03-14 (subject to verification).
investigation_notes: Sanitizer code path: edge-identity-proxy v2.11.0 introduced a normalization pass to strip non-alphanumeric segments; the regex /(?:":role:)([a-z]+):[0-9]+:/ was overly greedy and removed the 'project:1234:' segment entirely.
RBAC engine expects exact role identifiers to include resource scoping; mapping fallback logic treats single-term roles as organization-level roles, not matching project bindings.
Reproduction run: unit test added to auth-integration suite reproduces failure when input contains 'urn:atlas:role:project:1234:admin'.
Risk assessment: Medium-High — impacts admin workflows only (not end-user inference), but customer operations are blocked; private customers expect fast remediation.

Workaround verified: Customer can configure IdP to duplicate full namespaced role into a secondary claim which currently bypasses sanitizer (x-redwood-roles-preserve). This is acceptable short-term but not ideal.
Root cause commit: 7a3f2c (edge-identity-proxy) introduced greedy replace. See linked PR.
Related tickets: SUP-89321 (idp-proxy-path-prefix), SUP-71855 (scim rolecache) - similar auth plumbing changes in same release window.
resolution: Workaround provided (IdP duplicate claim) and hotfix PR prepared. Pending canary rollout and verification.
resolution_notes: Patch modifies sanitizer regex to whitelist namespaced segments like 'project:<id>' and adds a feature flag 'SANITIZER_PRESERVE_NAMESPACE' defaulting to true for Private deployments. Unit/integration tests added. Engineering to coordinate rollback if unforeseen regressions during canary. Customer will be notified about planned maintenance window for patch application on 2026-03-14.
